lens: geometry and proportion first, then materials and colour, then lighting on the seats, then artefacts. Evidence: r10 QA views q15-q18 plus 10 studio close-ups, compared against the official y_47300-07 photos (colour and finish) and the SANspotter / fr57325 in-service photos (geometry). Measurements were taken with PIL/numpy: Otsu light fraction, L percentiles, hex medians and gradient anisotropy gy/gx. Crops are in /tmp/claude-0/raterB10/ (diamond_cmp, mosaic_cmp, tick_cmp, fleck_cmp, belt, tiles, q16z, q17z).

priorIssues.status: fixed in studio; overshoots in cabin (partly from the lighting change)
priorIssues.evidence: Studio e4 cover/back L50 77.6 / 47.0 = 1.65, against y_47306 middle 1.62 and right 1.28. In the cabin, q15 s3 gives 109.9 / 37.3 = 2.94, q15 s4 2.17, q16 2nd row 2.09 and q16 near 2.34. The photos give 0.54 (y_47300 s3), 0.80-1.16 (y_47301) and 1.28-1.62 (y_47306). The covers now read as pale lavender-grey cards (#656c8c) on near-black backs.

priorIssues.issue: w9a-2 / w9b-2 dash mosaic clumped on a diagonal checker into blobs
priorIssues.evidence: The diagonal clumping is gone. q15 s2 light fraction 0.41, against y_47306 R 0.31 and y_47302 L 0.42. gy/gx 1.35, against photo 1.18-1.47 (r9 1.88). The dashes still stack 3-4 high into chunky vertical bars with navy gaps (mosaic_cmp.png). The photo cells are a fine, even field of 1 px horizontal dashes with only gentle density changes from cell to cell.

priorIssues.issue: w9a-3 / w9b-1 diamond overcorrected (fuzzy, holed, figure/ground inverted)
priorIssues.evidence: The figure and ground are back the right way round. q15 s1 light fraction 0.22, against y_47306 L 0.20 and y_47302 M 0.19 (r9 0.47). Light/dark L ratio 2.1, against 1.9-2.0. p90/p50 2.01, against 1.56-1.69, so slightly too contrasty. The figures are now uniform, crisp-edged, isolated diamonds of one size on a regular lattice (diamond_cmp.png, tiles.png). The photo figures are irregular, ragged, ikat-blurred stepped diamonds of mixed sizes that chain and overlap along the diagonals. They also measure about 0.07-0.085 m against the render's ~0.05 m (back width 170 px / 120 px in the photos, diamonds 30-35 / 20 px).

priorIssues.issue: w9b-3 tick weave too light and densely streaked, no dark vertical channels
priorIssues.evidence: q15 s3 light fraction 0.39, between y_47306 M 0.29 and y_47300 s1/s3 0.52-0.53. gy/gx 0.57, against photo 0.53-0.63. The light/dark ratio now matches y_47306 M. issues.title: Cross-area (lighting/integration): commits 282136c / 9f2d20e darkened the whole economy block, both fabric and shells
issues.evidence: Same econ geometry, r9 vs r10 renders. Fabric L50 in q15 went from 44-67 to 27-37; the photos give 46-99 (y_47300 / 47306). Back shells: q17 row 2 went from #9da1a7 (L160) to #62656c (L101), and q18 from L173 to L125, against y_47303 L178-198 and y_47305 L192. The top band of the frame is unchanged (199 to 201) and so are the studio renders. That isolates the cause to the new aoW for non-up faces (0.35 + 0.65 ao) and the crevice term amb *= mix(0.4, 1, smoothstep(0.06, 0.5, ao)) in 04_shaders.js, which hit vertical seat backs inside the low-AO economy block. The satin covers keep their cove specular, so cover/back flipped to 2.1-2.9x.
issues.fix: Lighting owner (04_shaders.js / 12_scene.js): apply the crevice term only at ao < 0.25, or exempt faces with |N.y| < 0.3 above y 0.5 m. Alternatively clamp aoW at >= 0.6 for v_wpos.y > 0.45 in the seat zones (sz = 1). Target: q15 fabric L50 50-70, q17/q18 shell L50 >= 175. Do not compensate in SEATMAT.

issues.title: Diamond figures are uniform, isolated, crisp decals; the photo shows irregular ikat diamonds chained along diagonals, ~50 % larger
issues.evidence: diamond_cmp.png and tiles.png: render diamonds ~0.05 m, all one size, sharp straight edges, on a regular grid with ground between. y_47306 L: ragged stepped diamonds 0.07-0.085 m, mixed sizes, touching corner to corner in diagonal chains, with soft, broken edges and specks. y_47302 M: the same, at lower contrast. p90/p50 2.01 vs 1.56-1.69.
issues.fix: In test/make_swatches.py y_diamond: scale figures 1.4x (about 0.07 m), randomise each figure's size by 0.7-1.3 and offset it by ±15 % of the pitch. Fill ~80 % of lattice sites so neighbours touch at their corners along one diagonal. Jitter the dash-run end points by ±25 % of the half-width so the edges look ragged and stepped, not straight. Blend the figure at 70 % with a 1 px blur. Add small satellite diamonds (0.3x) at about 30 % of the empty sites. Bring the lift down so the light/dark L ratio is about 1.9 and p90/p50 about 1.7.

issues.title: Headrest cover reads as a rigid slab or plaque: hard bevelled top edge, flat face, drop too short
issues.evidence: q16z.png: the near cover shows a thick lit bevel along its top and a flat planar face, like a hinged lid. y_47301 near and sans_13 show a soft leatherette flap rolled over the headrest top, with a rounded fold and slight sag. The drop below the pad bottom is 10 % of pad height in e4 (pad 170-315, cover 165-330). y_47306 R shows 29 % (pad 190-365, cover 180-415) and sans_13 near about 24 %. In the cabin it is also 2-3x the back luminance (w10b-1).
issues.fix: In 09a_econ.js: replace the 4-section fold loft (lines 64-65) with a 6-8 section roll of radius ~0.02 m that wraps the pad top (sections at 0.765-0.785 with depth following a semicircle). Add 2-3 mm of sag to the face (bow the middle section 0.003 m forward). Extend the flap 0.035 m lower, from the 0.585 start to 0.55, moving the hem band and logo with it. Once the lighting is fixed, raise yCover r from 0.38 to 0.48 so cove specular cannot push the cover past ~1.6x the back.

issues.title: Dash mosaic stacks into chunky vertical bars; the photo is a fine, even brick field of 1 px horizontal dashes
issues.evidence: mosaic_cmp.png: in q15 s2, groups of 3-4 thick dashes merge into vertical blobs with wide navy gaps. y_47306 R shows dashes covering the whole cell area, finer and shorter, with gentle cell-to-cell density change (light 0.31; render 0.41). The tile shows dense columns at 48 % next to near-empty columns at 22 %, which is the contrast that reads as bars.
issues.fix: In make_swatches.py y_mosaic: halve the dash thickness (1 px at the tile scale) and space the dashes at 2 px, so a cell holds 6-8 dash rows. Narrow the dense/sparse occupancy to 40 % / 28 % and jitter each dash's x-start within the cell so the dashes do not line up vertically. Keep the half-cell column stagger. Target light fraction 0.30-0.34.

issues.title: Belts are one-tone teal; ANA uses a teal tongue half and a dark navy buckle half
issues.evidence: y_47303 near seat: tongue strap #3576b8-#4b8bc9 and buckle strap #1d3281-#223a84, with a bright metal lift latch. y_47302 straps read dark (#3b4779). Render e1/e4b shows both halves #3f80b8.
issues.fix: In 09a_econ.js belt builder: give the buckle-side strap a new SEATMAT.yBeltD {c:'#1f2c55', r:0.85, l:LAYER.fabric} and keep yBelt on the tongue side. Make the latch {c:'#b9bdc4', r:0.3, m:0.8}.

issues.title: Pillow bow-tie concavity overdone (bone or dog-chew outline)
issues.evidence: e4b: the top edge dips about 14 % of the pillow height at mid-span. y_47300 pillows are near-rectangles whose sides dip only ~4-6 %, with sharp dog-ear corners and a puffy dome.
issues.fix: In 09a_econ.js pillow: cut the waist pinch from (1 - 0.18 * ...) to (1 - 0.07 * ...) on both axes, keep pull = 1 + 0.15 |XZ|, and weaken the centre dimple from 0.25 to 0.12.

issues.title: Seat pans wash out to pale grey-blue under top light (studio)
issues.evidence: Pans: e1 L50 106-126 and e4b 149, B/R 1.37-1.50. Photo pans y_47300 / 47302 / 47303: L50 63-88, B/R 1.58-1.82. The tick light streaks dominate the up-facing pans.
issues.fix: Give the pan material a darker, more saturated base than the back: add SEATMAT.yFabricPan {c: photoBase('#4a557a', 'y_tick'), r:0.92, l:LAYER.yJacq} and use it in econPan for the tick entries. Alternatively scale the photo-layer lift down by 0.8 for faces with N.y > 0.6 in this material.

issues.title: Tick weave lacks the column channels of y_47300
issues.evidence: tick_cmp.png: y_47300 s1/s3 show distinct columns of short ticks with navy gaps about 1.2-1.5 cm apart (light 0.52). The render reads as uniform rain. y_47306 M (light 0.29) is closer to the render, so a mild column modulation would serve both.
issues.fix: In make_swatches.py y_tick: multiply the tick density by a column mask, 0.55 + 0.45 * smoothstep on a 1.3 cm period with a ~0.4 cm dark channel, phase-jittered per tile row.

questionsForUser: Belts: the official y_47303 shows a teal tongue strap with a dark navy buckle strap, but y_47302 shows both straps dark. Do the economy belts on your rotations mix colours, or are they all dark?

Headrest covers: y_47300 shows them darker than the fabric, y_47306 lighter. Do you have an in-flight photo of a 777-300ER economy cover in neutral light, to fix the target cover/back ratio (currently aimed at about 1.3-1.6)?
Diamond fabric: the official photos show diamond backs on only a few seats. Do you know roughly how common the diamond and mosaic variants are compared with tick and fleck?
